input: Scheduled ventures brief: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (full routine prompt)
task: Deepen (flagship 5) einvoice-preflight: Peppol BIS 3.0.22 rules + compiler let fix

errors.what: First venture-preflight run failed on post front matter (description 183 > 160 chars, seo_title 85 > 70)
node_modules symlink (for local fontoxpath) was staged by git add -A

doc_friction.issue: Its buildable items are mostly 'read the law from host X'. This session's network allows only GitHub, npm, PyPI and Maven: boe.es, slov-lex.sk, financnasprava.sk, eur-lex, legifrance and the rest all answered 403 at CONNECT. An item that depends on a host should say so, so a run can check before it picks the item.
Overwrote plain/manifest.json with only its own 7 sets, so a rerun would have silently dropped the 37 PINT/ZATCA/CIUS/NLCIUS entries. Fixed in this PR (merge + EINVOICE_PLAIN_ONLY).

deviations.why: The next: items needed outside hosts (law texts) or real inputs, and this session's network blocks those hosts. Instead I took an item that hadn't been listed: the bundled Peppol rules were stale (3.0.20; 3.0.21 mandatory since 2026-08-17).
deviations.did: Updated to 3.0.22, ran OpenPeppol's own unit tests through the compiled rules, and fixed the compiler bug they exposed
deviations.result: 1,048/1,048 unit asserts agree (was 775/899 even on the old release's own tests)

goal: Keep the e-invoice checker's official rule sets current and provably faithful to their publishers' tests
notes: Local verification: run_venture_tests.py einvoice-preflight ok (0 failed, twice: after the rule update and after the compiler fix); peppol-bis-3022.test.mjs 14 pass; eval/peppol-unit-tests.mjs on OpenPEPPOL 38d693d 1048/1048 (shipped rules: 775/899 on 261c458's own tests, 808/1048 on 38d693d); phive-corpus --good --files on phive-rules 37a2664 byte-identical before/after; OpenPeppol 3.0.22 examples 9/10 -> 10/10 clean; venture-preflight rerun after the front-matter fix (see PR). Saxon route not rebuilt (it clones master at image build).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior e-invoicing engineer: diff two Peppol releases, write a unit-test runner, find and fix a Schematron let-scoping bug, rebuild and re-verify 13 rule sets, write-ups

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
